channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: School board seeks estimates for bus garage repair
item.description: The Wilson County Board of Education seeks cost comparisons to rebuild or renovate its fire-damaged bus garage. The board also advanced a $42 million state-funded plan to construct the new Wells-Hearne Elementary School.

item.title: Lead Brain Injury Case Manager
item.description: Neuro Community Care, LLC seeks Lead Brain Injury Case Manager in Wake Forest, NC. Provide consults for clients with brain injuries, neurological conditions, and cognitive/physical challenges. Send resume to sfriedman@neurocc.com.

item.title: Area Calendar, Jan. 14-15, 2026
item.description: Area prep sports for Jan. 14-15 feature full slates of boys and girls basketball, wrestling, winter track, swimming and JV action across local schools.

item.title: Patriots surge past Bulldogs 67-42
item.description: Francis Marion used a dominant third quarter and 29 points off turnovers to pull away from Barton 67-42, led by Kiara Croskey’s 22 points in the Conference Carolinas matchup.

item.title: Barton rally falls short in OT vs. FMU, 61-59
item.description: Barton erases late nine-point deficit to force overtime but falls 61-59 to Francis Marion on a final-minute alley-oop; Jaylen Faber scores 18, Trevur Smalls adds 16 in Conference Carolinas clash.

item.title: AREA ROUNDUP: Warriors defeat Knights 74-61 to take control of Big Eas...
item.description: Hunt High took at least temporary control of the Big East boys basketball race with a 74-61 win at previously unbeaten Northern Nash, while Fike stayed close with a 76-51 romp at Southern Wayne.

item.title: Lady Chargers fade in 4th vs. Patriots, 37-29
item.description: Fourth-quarter drought costs Wilson Christian as Parrott Academy pulls away 37-29 after losing Hoskins to injury; McBryde tallies 8 points, 10 rebounds in Lady Chargers’ nonconference defeat.

item.title: Parrott pulls away from WCA boys in 4th quarter, 56-47
item.description: Parrott Academy used a strong fourth quarter to top Wilson Christian 56-47, despite 14 points each from Aidan Tant and Cam Efird, setting up WCA’s key East clash at Hilltop Christian on Friday.

item.title: Wilson Prep girls hammer Washington Co. in ECAC debut
item.description: Top-ranked Wilson Prep opened 1-A Eastern Carolina play with a 77-33 rout of Washington County, led by MyAngel Brimage’s 19 points and double-doubles from Paris Best and Chloe Murphy.

item.title: Atkinson’s 5 treys spark Tigers to birthday win
item.description: Freshman Trey Atkinson hit five 3-pointers and scored 15 points as Wilson Prep topped Washington County 61-49 in its ECAC opener, snapping a two-game skid on head coach and father Anthony Atkinson Jr.’s birthday.
